name: Zip
description: Let agents read purchase requests, approvals, purchase orders, invoices, vendors and agreements in Zip. For matching quotes and invoices to requests and POs, chasing stalled approvals, renewal checks and spend reports. Agents never submit, approve or pay.
identity: A Zip restricted API key with read-only access to the record types you choose. It is not tied to a person and can change nothing.

setup.title: Create a restricted, read-only API key
setup.body: Create the key as a Zip admin. Choose Restricted, then Read only for each kind of record agents read: requests, approvals and comments, purchase orders and invoices, vendors and agreements, and departments if you keep agents to chosen departments. Zip shows the key only once.
click: In Zip, select the settings icon at the top right > Company settings > Setup > API > API keys.
Select + Create API key > Restricted. Name: AI agents. Set an expiration date if your policy asks for one.
For each record type above, choose Read only. Leave every other record type without access.
Select Create and copy the key.

setup.title: Test the key
setup.body: The command below counts your requests and changes nothing.

capabilities.label: Read purchase requests
capabilities.description: Search purchase requests by number, status, type, vendor, department or date, and read one request with its amounts, line items, vendor, owner, custom fields and linked purchase order.
capabilities.note: Read-only. Reaches every request the key can read unless you keep a key to chosen departments.

capabilities.label: Read approvals and comments
capabilities.description: Search approval steps by request, status or due date to see who still has to approve, and read a request's comments and questionnaire answers.
capabilities.note: Read by request number or id, so these are not held to the departments you choose for a key.

capabilities.label: Read purchase orders and invoices
capabilities.description: Search and read purchase orders, with what has been billed against them, and supplier invoices with their status, amounts and matched purchase orders.
capabilities.note: Not held to the departments you choose for a key.

capabilities.label: Read vendors and agreements
capabilities.description: Search and read vendors, and list agreements with their dates, amounts and renewal status.
capabilities.note: Not held to the departments you choose for a key.

limits.label: Departments
limits.help: Optional: only purchase requests of these departments, shown under Departments after connecting (the first 100; type any other department's id). Covers searching and reading requests only. Leave empty for every department.

revoke: In Zip, open Company settings > Setup > API > API keys and delete the AI agents key. Agents lose access to Zip at once.

tools.name: zip_search_requests
tools.description: Search purchase requests, newest first. Times are seconds since 1970. Pass next from the answer as page_token for the next page.

request_number.description: The request number, as shown in Zip

status.description: Only requests in this status: 1 awaiting approval, 2 rejected, 3 approved, 4 canceled, 5 closed, 6 paused

department_id.description: Only requests of these department ids

vendor_id.description: Only requests for this vendor id

vendor_name.description: Only requests for this vendor name

created_after.description: Only requests created after this time

created_before.description: Only requests created before this time

completed_after.description: Only requests completed after this time

last_updated_after.description: Only requests updated after this time

page_size.description: How many per page, at most 30

page_token.description: The next value of the previous answer

tools.name: zip_get_request
tools.description: Read one purchase request: description, status and why, vendor, department, requester and owner, amounts and line items, term and renewal dates, custom fields and its purchase order.

request_id.description: The request's id (not its number), from zip_search_requests

tools.name: zip_search_approvals
tools.description: Search approval steps, such as those still waiting or past due, with their assignee and request. Times are seconds since 1970. Pass next from the answer as page_token for the next page.

request_number.description: Only approvals of this request number

status.description: Only approvals in this status: 0 upcoming, 1 ready to start (waiting on the approver), 2 rejected, 3 approved, 4 approved automatically, 5 canceled, 6 to 8 a custom status of your company

due_before.description: Only approvals due before this time

due_after.description: Only approvals due after this time

started_after.description: Only approvals started after this time

completed_after.description: Only approvals completed after this time

page_size.description: How many per page, at most 100

page_token.description: The next value of the previous answer

tools.name: zip_list_request_comments
tools.description: List the comments on a purchase request, with their replies.

tools.name: zip_get_request_questionnaires
tools.description: Read the questionnaires answered on a purchase request, such as intake or security review questions, with each question and answer.

tools.name: zip_search_purchase_orders
tools.description: Search purchase orders, newest first. Times are seconds since 1970. Pass next from the answer as page_token for the next page.

po_number.description: The PO number. Works only if Zip has turned on extra PO search filters for your company

vendor_id.description: Only purchase orders of this vendor id

created_after.description: Only purchase orders created after this time

created_before.description: Only purchase orders created before this time

last_updated_after.description: Only purchase orders with activity after this time

open_amount_greater_than.description: Only purchase orders with more than this left open

page_size.description: How many per page, at most 50

page_token.description: The next value of the previous answer

tools.name: zip_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Read one purchase order: vendor, amounts billed and credited, dates, line items, change orders and the invoices against it.

purchase_order_id.description: The purchase order's id (not its PO number)

tools.name: zip_search_invoices
tools.description: Search supplier invoices, newest first. Times are seconds since 1970. Pass next from the answer as page_token for the next page.

vendor_id.description: Only invoices of this vendor id

created_after.description: Only invoices created after this time

created_before.description: Only invoices created before this time

updated_after.description: Only invoices updated after this time

invoice_amount_min.description: Only invoices of at least this amount

invoice_amount_max.description: Only invoices of at most this amount

line_items_count_only.description: Count line items instead of listing them

page_size.description: How many per page, at most 50

page_token.description: The next value of the previous answer

tools.name: zip_get_invoice
tools.description: Read one supplier invoice: amounts and tax, dates, vendor, matched purchase orders, approvals, coding and line items.

invoice_id.description: The invoice's id (not the supplier's invoice number)

tools.name: zip_search_vendors
tools.description: Search vendors by name or status. Pass next from the answer as page_token for the next page.

page_size.description: How many per page, at most 100

page_token.description: The next value of the previous answer

tools.name: zip_get_vendor
tools.description: Read one vendor: names, status, risk and tier, contacts, sites, categories and owners.

tools.name: zip_search_agreements
tools.description: List agreements, such as a vendor's contracts with their term, amount and renewal status. Pass next from the answer as page_token for the next page.

vendor_id.description: Only agreements with this vendor id

department_id.description: Only agreements of this department id

sort_by.description: What to sort by, newest first

page_size.description: How many per page, at most 100

page_token.description: The next value of the previous answer
